speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The sign is on all three. Once, lad. The new cue, and then stop. Not the act.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Once. I am saying it to the paper, not to the yard. If I lift it, tell me, and I will put it down.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: That was the new mouthful. I have just written it three times. My ear and my hand agree, which is more than they did at nine.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: The old one knocked, and I did not open. It is still in my head. It is not in my mouth. I can feel the difference, which is a small pride and I will not stretch it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Once is what the stock paid for. A second time is rehearsal, and rehearsal of this king is not this morning. The ink is not dry. Do not lean on it to feel proud.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou heardst him. Once is the whole of the bargain. When thou comest to the door on the day, the paper is the mouth. This was only to prove the mouth can find the paper.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I can find it. I will not describe the sign. I will not spend the old line on a joke at dinner, either. Abel would hear of the joke, and I like Abel more than I like a joke.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: Leave the weight where it is. A quarter of an hour, and a cuff will not lift the word off. I have a sleeve that has learned this.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A quarter of an hour, then. I am not standing over wet ink to admire a decision I have already made.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Nor I. The line goes in the book as copying, while the ink dries. Mouths are finished. Money is the part I can still do with a dry hand.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: May I go and be cold in the yard until you want me painted? There is nothing left for me to say that would help the paper.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Go and be cold. Do not gather a second opinion between here and the door. One opinion has been paid for.
